name: Johannes Vermeer
hook: The Dutch master of light behind "Girl with a Pearl Earring" and "The Milkmaid."

facts.label: Dutch master
facts.statement: Vermeer was a 17th-century Dutch master who painted in Delft; only about 35 of his paintings are known.

facts.label: Girl with a Pearl Earring (film)
facts.statement: The 2003 film "Girl with a Pearl Earring" stars Scarlett Johansson as the model and Colin Firth as Vermeer.

facts.label: Tracy Chevalier
facts.statement: Tracy Chevalier wrote the novel "Girl with a Pearl Earring," inspired by the painting; her surname means "knight."

facts.label: The Milkmaid
facts.statement: "The Milkmaid," also called "The Kitchen Maid," hangs in Amsterdam's Rijksmuseum, which also holds "Woman in Blue Reading a Letter."

facts.label: View of Delft
facts.statement: "View of Delft" is his cityscape of Delft, painted a few years after a devastating powder-magazine explosion there.

facts.label: camera obscura
facts.statement: Some scholars think Vermeer used a camera obscura — Latin for "dark chamber" — to achieve his paintings' photographic look.

facts.label: Han van Meegeren
facts.statement: Forger Han van Meegeren sold fake Vermeers to Nazis including Hermann Goering, then proved the forgery to escape a death sentence.
